    const std::size_t element_width = 1U;
    const std::size_t remaining_bytes = field->bytes.size() - element_offset;
    if (element_width == 0U || element_count > remaining_bytes / element_width || remaining_bytes != element_count * element_width) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    for (std::size_t index = 0U; index < element_count; ++index) {
      const auto decoded = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_bool(field->bytes.subspan(element_offset, element_width));
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      elements.push_back(*decoded.value);
      element_offset += element_width;
    }
    if (!builder.set_flags(std::move(elements))) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  if (const auto* field = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::find_field(*parsed.record, 7U); field != nullptr) {
    std::size_t element_offset = 0U;
    const auto decoded_count = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
    if (!decoded_count.value.has_value() || *decoded_count.value > 3U) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    const auto element_count = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_count.value);
    std::vector<std::int16_t> elements;
    elements.reserve(element_count);
    const std::size_t element_width = 2U;
    const std::size_t remaining_bytes = field->bytes.size() - element_offset;
    if (element_width == 0U || element_count > remaining_bytes / element_width || remaining_bytes != element_count * element_width) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    for (std::size_t index = 0U; index < element_count; ++index) {
      const auto decoded = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_i16(field->bytes.subspan(element_offset, element_width));
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      elements.push_back(*decoded.value);
      element_offset += element_width;
    }
    if (!builder.set_deltas(std::move(elements))) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  if (const auto* field = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::find_field(*parsed.record, 8U); field != nullptr) {
    std::size_t element_offset = 0U;
    const auto decoded_count = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
    if (!decoded_count.value.has_value() || *decoded_count.value > 2U) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    const auto element_count = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_count.value);
    std::vector<float> elements;
    elements.reserve(element_count);
    const std::size_t element_width = 4U;
    const std::size_t remaining_bytes = field->bytes.size() - element_offset;
    if (element_width == 0U || element_count > remaining_bytes / element_width || remaining_bytes != element_count * element_width) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    for (std::size_t index = 0U; index < element_count; ++index) {
      const auto decoded = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_f32(field->bytes.subspan(element_offset, element_width));
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      elements.push_back(*decoded.value);
      element_offset += element_width;
    }
    if (!builder.set_ratios(std::move(elements))) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  if (const auto* field = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::find_field(*parsed.record, 9U); field != nullptr) {
    const auto decoded = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_bool(field->bytes);
    if (!decoded.value.has_value() || !builder.set_active(*decoded.value)) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  if (const auto* field = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::find_field(*parsed.record, 10U); field != nullptr) {
    std::size_t element_offset = 0U;
    const auto decoded_count = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
    if (!decoded_count.value.has_value() || *decoded_count.value > 3U) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    const auto element_count = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_count.value);
    std::vector<std::string> elements;
    elements.reserve(element_count);
    for (std::size_t index = 0U; index < element_count; ++index) {
      const auto decoded_length = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
      if (!decoded_length.value.has_value() || *decoded_length.value > 8U) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      const auto element_length = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_length.value);
      if (element_length > field->bytes.size() - element_offset) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      const auto element_bytes = field->bytes.subspan(element_offset, element_length);
      const auto decoded = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_string_utf8(element_bytes);
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      elements.push_back(std::move(*decoded.value));
      element_offset += element_length;
    }
    if (element_offset != field->bytes.size()) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (!builder.set_tags(std::move(elements))) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  if (const auto* field = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::find_field(*parsed.record, 11U); field != nullptr) {
    std::size_t element_offset = 0U;
    const auto decoded_count = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
    if (!decoded_count.value.has_value() || *decoded_count.value > 3U) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    const auto element_count = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_count.value);
    std::vector<std::vector<std::byte>> elements;
    elements.reserve(element_count);
    for (std::size_t index = 0U; index < element_count; ++index) {
      const auto decoded_length = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_varuint(field->bytes, element_offset);
      if (!decoded_length.value.has_value() || *decoded_length.value > 3U) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      const auto element_length = static_cast<std::size_t>(*decoded_length.value);
      if (element_length > field->bytes.size() - element_offset) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      const auto element_bytes = field->bytes.subspan(element_offset, element_length);
      const auto decoded = ::breadcrumbs::runtime::read_bytes(element_bytes);
      if (!decoded.value.has_value()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      elements.push_back(std::move(*decoded.value));
      element_offset += element_length;
    }
    if (element_offset != field->bytes.size()) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (!builder.set_chunks(std::move(elements))) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  return builder.build();
}
